CODE 
Art. 2.3.80. 
Opposition by creditors 
The creditors of either spouse may object to the liquidation being carried out without their presence and intervene at their own expense.
They may also, within a period of six months from the expiry of the period provided for in Article 2.3.79, ¤ 2, appeal against a liquidation carried out in fraud of their rights.
